title: SAP Partner Summit for EMEA & MEE 2026
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
Vertex is proud to sponsor the SAP Partner Summit for EMEA & MEE, taking place 19-21 October in Amsterdam. This premier SAP ecosystem event brings together business leaders, technology experts, and partners from across the region to explore innovation, AI, cloud transformation, and opportunities for growth.


Meet the Vertex team on-site to discover how organisations can simplify global indirect tax, e-invoicing, and compliance while maximising the value of their SAP investments. Our experts will be available throughout the event to discuss current regulatory challenges, digital transformation initiatives, and strategies for building a future-ready tax function.


Whether you're evaluating your compliance roadmap, navigating evolving e-invoicing mandates, or looking to strengthen your SAP and tax technology strategy, we invite you to meet with Vertex during the summit.


For more information, please visit:[https://events.sap.com/partnersummits/en_us/emeamee.html#registernow](https://events.sap.com/partnersummits/en_us/emeamee.html#registernow)
